'''Gray Squadron''' was a [[New Jedi Order|Jedi]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] squadron active in [[44 ABY]]. Gray Squadron's [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] flew [[StealthX]] starfighters.

==History==
Gray Squadron fought in the [[Operation Shieldfall|battle]] against the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] and the [[Sith Meditation Sphere]] [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]] over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]]. With [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] in command, they ambushed the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith armada (Lost Tribe of the Sith)|armada]] upon their arrival in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]], and when [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] escaped from the surface of the world, he was given command of the squadron. They pursued [[Abeloth]] and Ship, damaging them until Skywalker was shot down by a [[Golan III Space Defense NovaGun]].
